questions.q: What did the angry King throw at the palace cat?
choices: His crown
His tooth-brush
A slipper
A pillow
questions.evidence: He threw his tooth-brush at the palace cat.

questions.q: Why did the Doctor have to carry Gub-Gub through the forest?
choices: Gub-Gub had hurt his foot on a sharp stone in the dark
Gub-Gub's short legs got tired
Gub-Gub was too frightened of the jungle to walk by himself
Gub-Gub had eaten too many dates and figs to walk
questions.evidence: Gub-Gub, with his short legs, soon got tired

questions.q: Why was the King wrong to think his army would easily find the Doctor?
choices: The Doctor had a map of the jungle that the swallow gave him
Polynesia flew ahead of them and warned them whenever the soldiers came near
Chee-Chee knew all the jungle paths even better than the King's men did
The King's soldiers were too sleepy to search very carefully
questions.evidence: Chee-Chee, knew all the paths through the jungle--better even than the King's men did

questions.q: Where did Chee-Chee hide the Doctor and the animals that first night?
choices: In a dark cave behind a waterfall
In a big hollow tree between high rocks
Under the roots of a giant palm-tree by a river
In an old empty house deep in the forest
questions.evidence: hid them all in a big hollow tree between high rocks

questions.q: How did the travelers make their lemonade in the jungle?
choices: With juice of wild oranges, sweetened with honey from bees' nests
With water from a cool jungle spring, mixed with crushed sugar-cane juice
With lemons the monkeys picked, sweetened with ripe dates
With milk from cocoanuts, mixed with ginger and figs
questions.evidence: lemonade out of the juice of wild oranges, sweetened with honey

questions.q: What did the travelers sleep in at night?
choices: Hammocks hung up high between the trees, made of twisted vines
Tents made of palm-leaves, on beds of dried grass
The hollow trunks of old trees, lined with moss
Under the stars, on blankets from the trunk
questions.evidence: they slept in tents made of palm-leaves

questions.q: How do monkeys remember their history, according to Chee-Chee?
choices: They carve pictures of it into the trunks of old trees
They write it down in history-books kept in a hollow tree
They tell stories of what happens to their children
They sing songs about it every night around the fire
questions.evidence: they remember everything that happens by telling stories to their children

questions.q: How did the King's men finally find out where the Doctor was?
choices: They heard the noise of the monkeys cheering to greet the Doctor
They followed the smoke from the Doctor's little fire of sticks
Gub-Gub cried so loudly that the soldiers heard him in the jungle
A bird flew back to the palace and told the King where to look
questions.evidence: had heard the noise of the monkeys cheering

questions.q: What stopped the Captain just as he was about to catch the Doctor?
choices: He fell into a deep swamp by the edge of the trees
He tripped over the Doctor's medicine-bag in the mud
One of his long ears caught fast in a tree
Jip the dog jumped up and barked at him
questions.evidence: one of his ears caught fast in a tree

questions.q: What did the monkeys make the bridge out of?
choices: Long boards they had hidden in the trees near the cliff
Strong vines and ropes tied across the deep river
Themselves, holding hands and feet
A big tree they pushed over the edge of the cliff
questions.evidence: made themselves into a bridge, just by holding hands and feet

questions.q: How did Gub-Gub feel walking across the bridge?
choices: He was so happy that he sang a song all the way across
He was a bit scared on the narrow bridge so high above the river
He was too frightened to cross, so one of the big monkeys carried him over
He was angry that he had to be the very first to go over
questions.evidence: Gub-Gub was a bit scared, walking on such a narrow bridge

questions.q: The bridge was "at that dizzy height above the river." What does "dizzy height" mean here?
choices: A place that is very wet and slippery
A place so high it could make you feel faint
A place that keeps moving back and forth
A place where the wind blows very hard
questions.evidence: at that dizzy height above the river

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: How Chee-Chee told the stories his grandmother had told him of the days before Noah and the Flood
How the Doctor and his animals escaped the King's army and reached the Land of the Monkeys
How the King's Captain got his long ear stuck fast in a tree
How Polynesia and Chee-Chee found food and drink in the jungle
questions.evidence: The Doctor and all his animals were safe in the Land of the Monkeys
